segments.oily: An oily-skin reviewer reports she was skeptical of an oil-based balm but found it worked well as the first step of a double cleanse; another notes it does not leave skin feeling oily or sticky after rinsing, unlike other balms she has tried.
segments.dry: Several dry-skin reviewers call it gentle, thorough and nurturing, saying it does not leave skin feeling dry or stripped and leaves it glowing; one with dry skin prone to breakouts and congestion still noticed a slight film and uses a washcloth to remove it.
segments.combination: No combination-skin reviews were reported in this set.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report mixed results: some say it does not irritate their eyes or dry out their skin, while others describe stinging or burning around the eyes and one links it to hormonal breakouts.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing their skin as normal report unexpected breakouts after use, despite not being acne-prone.
segments.mature: A 42-year-old reviewer with sensitive skin and hormonal acne calls it part of her holy-grail routine, crediting the wider Naturium line for visible improvement, though she does not isolate the balm's effect.

concerns.aging: One mature reviewer using this balm within a full Naturium routine reports being told she looks younger, but does not attribute this specifically to the balm rather than her whole regimen.
concerns.dehydration: Dry-skin reviewers generally report the balm does not leave skin feeling tight or stripped and can leave it glowing; one notes it is not especially hydrating on its own and pairs it with other moisturizing steps.
concerns.redness: Reviewers do not report new redness from the product itself, though several mention eye-area stinging or burning that some attribute to irritation rather than true redness.
concerns.barrier: Not enough reviewers describe barrier-specific concerns (e.g., compromised or reactive barrier) beyond general sensitivity and stinging around the eyes.
concerns.spots: No reviewers specifically discuss dark spots or hyperpigmentation in relation to this balm.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are split: some acne-prone or normal-skin reviewers say it broke them out badly, including under-the-skin pimples and clogged pores, especially after a formula change; other acne-prone reviewers say it caused no breakouts and even helped their skin.
concerns.oiliness: Many reviewers, regardless of stated skin type, describe a greasy or oily film left after rinsing that some find easily removed with a second cleanse and others find impossible to fully remove even with soap.

extraits.texte: I used to love this product for double cleansing. I would start with the cleansing balm and finish with a gentle gel cleanser and my skin loved it! tested and tried so many cleansing oils and balm and this was my absolute favorite. HOWEVER.... I HATE the formula change that occurred this year. I was my face TWICE with gel cleanser after using the new cleansing balm and it it still leaves residue. My pores have become clogged and I'm starting to break out. I'm so disappointed and annoyed to have to go back on the hunt for a new product.

extraits.texte: i was so excited to try this but it broke me out so bad for weeks on end. im not allergic to any of the ingredients, not acne prone, and have normal skin, so i dont know why it happened, but i will never purchase again.

My skin is normally very forgiving of new products and I am not acne prone at all, but two days into introducing these cleansing balm and the entire lower portion of my face is broken out. My partner is having the same reaction. After a little more research it seems as though this is a pretty common response. There are better balms out there.

This product is MY holy grail, but might not be for everyone. My skin always looks better when I consistently use this as a first cleanse and then I follow up with LaRoche Posay gentle hydrating cleanser. It does leave an oily feel to your skin so I recommend this for people who have dry skin. I took accutane in the past so I no longer struggle with breakouts, however I could see this causing breakouts for people who are sensitive to oils.

I was out of my other EL… balm and saw this was recommended on youtube. It was for dry skin that is prone to breakouts as it also had anti-fungal properties for acne. This is very emollient and easy to apply and remove makeup as a first cleanse. My skin Has looked great and I do use a wash cloth or paper towel as I feel slight film after using. Ibhave sensitive dry skin with some congestion in zone and so far I love this. This is gentle and not harsh, no strong smell. With a coupon this is a great buy for amount of product.

This is my favorite cleansing balm I've ever tried. The texture is amazing, gets all my waterproof makeup off without leaving a residue. I have sensitive, dry skin and this doesnt leave me feeling dry or irritate my skin. Also love that its fragrance free! I need them to come out with a mini for travel!

extraits.titre: Best make up remover for dry skin
extraits.texte: This cleansing balm is gentle, thorough, and nurturing to my very dry complexion. I massage it in, and follow with a warm, wet washcloth. My skin actually glows after cleansing with this balm!
